owner: KDB Infrastructure Asset Management / project company
notes: Incheon Today reported Michuhol-gu issued construction permission in April 2023 to KDB Infrastructure Asset Management for a large data center around 765-18 Dohwa-dong, with about 58,000 sqm site area, seven above-ground floors and roughly 80 MW. Korea JoongAng Daily and Yonhap reported continuing resident opposition in 2026; public reports indicate the project is delayed but not cancelled.
